hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Africa, bordering the Bight of Biafra, between Cameroon and Gabon || coastal plains rise to interior hills; islands are volcanic || insular and continental regions widely separated; despite its name, no part of the equator passes through Equatorial Guinea -- the mainland part of the country is located just north of the equator || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, timber, gold, bauxite, diamonds, tantalum, sand and gravel, clay || Exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, alcohols, wood, scrap iron (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: coastal plains rise to interior hills; islands are volcanic || Central Africa, bordering the Bight of Biafra, between Cameroon and Gabon

climate.excerpt: tropical; always hot, humid || violent windstorms; flash floods volcanism: Santa Isabel (3,007 m), which last erupted in 1923, is the country's only historically active volcano; Santa Isabel and two dormant volcanoes form Bioko Island in the Gulf of Guinea

economy.excerpt: growing CEMAC economy and new OPEC member; large oil and gas reserves; targeting economic diversification and poverty reduction; still recovering from CEMAC crisis; improving public financial management; persistent poverty; hard-hit by COVID-19 || Exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, alcohols, wood, scrap iron (2023) || Industries: petroleum, natural gas, sawmilling
